name: Stättared - Veddige
description: Stättared to Veddige. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Dricksvatten vid Veddige station: Drinking-water tap outside the toilet at Veddige bus/train station; Varberg municipality is listed as responsible.
Dricksvatten Stättareds gård: Water refill at Stättareds 4H-gård via side path from the trail.
notes: Find official Veddige station parking coordinates and posted time limits before importing parking metadata.
Run protected-area polygon overlay before final normalization to confirm whether Skoga or any other protected area intersects the N4 GPX.
No exact 2025-2026 first-person hiking report for the current post-2024 Stättared - Veddige alignment was found; use recent corridor reports only as caveated condition evidence.

Timing note: No official section-specific hiking time found. The official Hallandsleden page and API provide distance and difficulty only. At Hallandsleden's general planning pace of about 4 km/hour, 15 km implies about 3 h 45 min moving time, but this is not an official value and the red/hard grading reflects hilly and sometimes wet terrain.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Stättared
facilities.description: Shelter for 4-5 adults at Stora Hornsjön with two fireplaces, toilet, bathing place and fishing nearby. Drinking water is at Stättareds 4H-gård, not at the shelter. Exact toilet placement needs normalization; sources associate toilet service with the Stättared shelter/farm cluster. Fire use depends on current fire-risk and fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Rastplats vid Hornsjön
facilities.description: Rest point with seating and view over Stora Hornsjön. Likely overlaps unnamed local viewpoint objects; avoid duplicate OSM-derived viewpoint imports unless later normalized.

facilities.name: Torpet Dalen
facilities.description: Ruin of a former ridge-roof croft associated with Anna Charlotta 'Bär-Lotta' Friberg.

facilities.name: Stenhäll med inskriptioner
facilities.description: Inscribed stone slab near the trail; official text mentions names and the year 1864.

facilities.name: Björkholmens Glamping
facilities.description: Private bookable glamping at southwest Stora Hornsjön with running water, fireplace, toilet, shower and lake bathing nearby. Official text says 200 m from Hallandsleden while GPX proximity computes about 10 m; Check active booking/current availability before public use. Do not model private water/toilet/fireplace as public trail facilities.

facilities.name: Stenbro från förr
facilities.description: Old flat-stone bridge on a former track near Ärsjöarna. Official text warns hikers to be careful on the stones at high water.

facilities.name: Fin utsikt
facilities.description: Small viewpoint/rest point with forest views.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten vid Veddige station
facilities.description: Drinking-water tap outside the toilet at Veddige bus/train station; Varberg municipality is listed as responsible.

facilities.name: Toalett Veddige station
facilities.description: Public toilet at Veddige bus/train station, open year-round 07:00-23:00 according to official place text; drinking water is available outside.

facilities.name: Hemköp Veddige
facilities.description: Grocery store in central Veddige; official Hallandsleden text says open 08:00-21:00 daily. Check store opening hours before public use.

facilities.name: Hållplats - Veddige Station
facilities.description: Endpoint bus/train access at Veddige station; official text mentions Hallandstrafiken bus 616 and train service on Viskadalsbanan.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten Stättareds gård
facilities.description: Water refill at Stättareds 4H-gård via side path from the trail. Check whether the tap is accessible when farm/cafe buildings are unmanned. Do not model as water at the Stättared shelter itself.

facilities.name: Stättareds 4H-gård & vandrarhem
facilities.description: 4H farm, hostel, seasonal cafe, tent/camper options and paid parking; farm grounds are described as year-round while cafe hours are seasonal/weekend-based. Exact parking-lot coordinate should be verified before point import. Dogs are welcome but must be leashed around farm animals.

facilities.name: Hållplats Stättaredsvägen
facilities.description: Bus stop for Stättared access; official text says 2.6 km walk to Stättareds 4H-gård, then local path to Hallandsleden.

facilities.name: Hållplats Backen
facilities.description: Alternative Stättared access stop; official text says 4.4 km walk to Stättareds 4H-gård.
